description: Move an existing block up or down in the editor by clicking the block toolbar's Move up / Move down button. Selects the block first, then presses the move button `count` times. blockType is the block's kebab-case slug (e.g. paragraph, heading, cover); index is zero-based when multiple blocks of the same type exist.
examples: move the cover block down two spots
move the third heading down three spots
label: Move the {{blockType}} block {{direction}}
